subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Hexaaquanickel(II)（[Ni(H₂O)₆]²⁺）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Trigonal planar
D. Trigonal bipyramidal
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: Ni (group 10) 10 e; 6 × H₂O (L) 12 e; the 2+ charge removes 2 e: 20 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry no charge and the complex has a 2+ charge, so the metal is Ni(II), d⁸; d⁸ + 12 e from the ligands = 20 e.
